english:
Elemental Pickup interactions progress a counter, granting 1 stack of Armor Charge upon reaching 100% Progress.

Counter Threshold: 20|14|10 points with one, two, or three mods equipped.

Progress gained:
• <solar/>Firesprites and <void/>Void Breaches: 10 points per pickup
• <strand/>Tangles: 10 points when destroyed
• <arc/>Ionic Traces: 7 points per pickup
• <stasis/>Stasis Shards: 5 points per pickup

The counter resets to 0 after granting Armor Charge.

source.text:
Elemental Pickup Interactions progress a counter.
Grants x1 Armor Charge upon reaching 100% Progress.

Counter Threshold: 20 | 14 | 10 Points
Firesprites, Void Breaches: +10 per pickup.
Tangles: +10 upon destroying.
Ionic Traces: +7 per pickup.
Small/Large Shards: +5 per pickup.
Counter resets to 0 upon triggering.
